name: DeploymentDecision
description: Decides whether an automated deployment should continue, roll back, pause, or escalate.

action_descriptions.continue: The deployment is healthy; let it proceed.
action_descriptions.rollback: Revert the deployment to the previous version.
action_descriptions.pause: Hold the deployment without reverting while more signal is gathered.
action_descriptions.human_review: Escalate to a human before taking any further automated action.
